paragraphs: I’m a software developer from Bahia, Brazil. At EloGroup, I went from software engineering intern to Forward Deployed Engineer. I worked on JavaScript systems for the public sector, from gathering requirements with clients to implementing business rules, integrating services, and migrating data.
Outside work, I write about what I learn from digging into
. Lately, I’ve been exploring how data moves through files, streams, and TCP connections.
